text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Hooorrrraaaayyyyyyy!!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (Shine, Tarumae!! This is my—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (This is how I repay Acute-san...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —A changing of the guard, is it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute-san...—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Total defeat, huh~. And here I thought today was the day I was seriously, truly gonna win.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I won't let any passing of the torch happen.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san, you've got so much more to give!
You'll be shining on the dirt frontlines with me for a long time yet!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't want that!
When Falco-san comes back here someday,
for Acute-san not to be here...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"As part of 'our' generation!
Don't you want to run alongside Falco-san?!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Acute-san, your role is to join me
in completely wiping the floor
with Rickey when she arrives!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my,
Tarumae-chan, that's pretty mean of you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ......I still gotta keep working hard!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Hokko Tarumae~~!! Congrats~~!!
You really are the strongest Umamusume on dirt~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was amaziiing!!
I've got high hopes for you in the Champions Cup!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
May I make a declaration here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even without asking, I knew what her declaration was aimed at.
And so, I responded with a firm nod.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone! Thank you so very much
for all your support today!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to take this opportunity today to make a declaration!!
I, Hokko Tarumae, am—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: She emerged victorious in both of this year's races: the Champions Cup and the Tokyo Daishoten!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'll aim to shine at the pinnacle of the dirt track!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Following Hokko Tarumae's recent declaration,
all eyes are on the year-end dirt race—"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—Will it be Hokko Tarumae, closest to the throne,
or the veteran Wonder Acute?! Or perhaps
the rising star, Copano Rickey—?!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since the 'JBC Classic' the other day,
I can feel the media paying more
and more attention to dirt races."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was little time left before the decisive battle.
Determined to build up whatever I could, little by little,
I was quietly working alone when—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Tarumae-chan's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to bother you while you look busy!
Do you have just a moment?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to thank you for everything you've done for Tarumae-chan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yup♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I wanted to say a big thank-you for supporting Tarumae-chan this far!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You know, to tell the truth... Falco was feeling just a tiny bit burned out.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Taking on so many challenges, shining so bright,
striving to sparkle, putting in the effort as if it were only natural—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
However, even so...
Thinking that "maybe I can't do any more"—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just for an instant...
Just for a single second, the thought crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “But, Acute-san... and Tarumae-chan gave it to me.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The kindling that will make me shine once more...!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —The Tokyo Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"That's the quickest return I can aim for right now.
Honestly, whether I can actually run or not is fifty-fifty.
...Still."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I can't make it in time for the Tokyo Daishoten,
my promise to run with Tarumae-chan one day—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I hope you'll wait for me.
Tarumae-chan's Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How could they not wait?
I'm sure it's something everyone dreams of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A dream race full of brilliance,
bringing together Hokko Tarumae and those bound to her
by strong ties of fate!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...To tell the truth...
There's something I want to entrust to you
and Tarumae-chan."
choice_data_list: Something you want to entrust to me...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
But this is still a secret♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I just want you to quietly hold onto the fact
that there are feelings I want to entrust to you,
Trainer☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, sorry for bothering you while you're working!
See ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first decisive battle, the Champions Cup,
was fast approaching—
